spec_match.rationale: Grounded in the real decision the enum encodes (RFC 9002 §7 lets senders choose a controller) and ends every path in a genuine construction plus attribute readback — the advice table is explicitly labelled judgment, the readback labelled spec.

interactive.rationale: Six selectable workload cards (aria-pressed state), per-card rationale and constructor line, and a construct button that builds a real session with the chosen preference and reports the readback.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises workload matching plus a real construction readback; both present, plus the cheat-sheet section.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-WebTransport, attribute-absent (ignored dictionary member called out as not-support), honored, and downgraded outcomes with distinct wording.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5180947573112832 and RFC 9002 §7; crumbs reach the full feature reference list.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's honored-or-downgraded assertion is the exact contract the readback panel reports.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): six cards rendered, first card selected (aria-pressed true, rationale + constructor line shown), construction run (honest attribute-absent readback), selection moved to the file-sync card (previous card unpressed) and constructed again; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: honored readbacks need a 158+ build.

telemetry_health.rationale: wt-cc-picker-constructed assert fires per construction with the requested/got pair; promises claimed.

design_system.rationale: Cards use the dark-selected pattern with inherited pill inversion (button bg+color set together); readouts on bg-stone at AA.

accessibility.rationale: Workload cards are native buttons with aria-pressed in a labelled group, the rationale panel is aria-live=polite, 44px targets throughout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read; cards stack via auto-fit minmax(240px).

openQuestions.title: Validate the mapping against real honored readbacks on Chrome 158+
openQuestions.detail: On a 158+ build, construct each profile and record which preferences this platform honors; if low-latency is downgraded somewhere the advice table should note the platforms where only the default is available.

guidanceConsulted.query: selectable card group pressed state keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Selectable cards should be native buttons with aria-pressed and a labelled group; selection must be keyboard-operable.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Cards are <button aria-pressed> inside a role=group with aria-label; selection and construction are fully keyboard-driveable.

guidanceConsulted.query: selected state inversion nested badge contrast
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: When flipping a parent dark for selection, re-specify nested element colors.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The selected card flips to text-black/bg-ivory and its pill uses currentColor borders, so nested contrast holds in both states.

summary: Product decision page: six workloads mapped to profiles with rationale, each ending in a real construction and honest readback. Driven on headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): selection round-trip and two constructions verified, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
